cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
echo cores=$(nproc); free -m | head -2; uptime
echo --- TTL/загрузка свечей
grep -n "TTL\|ttl\|pages=\|def get_df_long" classic_panel.py | head -12
echo --- нагрузка процесса
ps -o pid,pcpu,pmem,etime,cmd -C python3 2>/dev/null | grep -i classic | head -3
for i in 1 2 3; do top -b -n1 -p $(systemctl show -p MainPID --value classicbot) | tail -1; sleep 4; done
